Muktijuddher Bijoy Natyotsob kicks off
2013-12-23T12:58:48+06:00 | Pranabesh Chakraborty, Chittagong
https://www.thedailystar.net/muktijuddher-bijoy-natyotsob-kicks-off-3543

On the first day of the 12-day theatre festival titled Muktijuddher Bijoy Natya Utsab-2013, theatre troupe Uttaradhikar staged their acclaimed play “Mritthupakhi” at Shilpakala Academy auditorium, Chittagong on Friday evening. Aiming at disseminating the history of 1971 among the present generation, Chittagong Group Theatre Forum, a leading association of theatre troupes in Chittagong, has organised the festival in association with District Shilpakala Academy with the theme “The Liberation War mirrored on stage”. Twelve theatre troupes of the port city are participating in the festival. Editor of a local daily Azadi, MA Malek inaugurated the festival as chief guest, followed by a short discussion. Presided over by Group Theatre Forum President Khaled Helal, the discussion was addressed among others by The Daily Star bureau Chief Raisul Huq Bahar; Additional Deputy Commissioner Md Rabbi Miyan and cultural personality Saiful Alam Babu. Featuring group and solo patriotic songs and dance, a cultural programme was also held where artistes of Shilpakala Academy gave performances. Later, a full house enjoyed “Mrithupakhi”. Penned by Tanvir Ahmed Sidney, the narrator -- featuring a bird in the play -- describes the real stories of the killers of 1971, known as Al-Badr and Razakars, which were published in the newspapers. Through the bird, the audience learns about the roots of massacre carried out in the country in 1971. Directed by Moslem Uddin Sikdar, the cast of the play included Asit Das, Mazharul Alam, Jahedul Alam and Roshnara Akhter. The light was designed by Moslem Uddin Sikder while Ali Ahmed Mukul planned the sets and costumes of the play.
